problem:
The function $V(t)$ models the number of visitors, in thousands, to a new website, $t$ hours after the website's launch. What is the best interpretation of the statement below?

$\,$ *The slope of the tangent line to the graph of $V(t)$ at $t=10$ is equal to $1.5.$*

choices.value: $10$ hours after launching, the number of visitors decreased by a total of $1\,500$ visitors
$10$ hours after launching, the number of visitors increased at a rate of $1\,500$ visitors per hour
$10$ hours after launching, the number of visitors increased at a constant rate of $150$ visitors per hour
$10$ hours after launching, the number of visitors increased by a total of $1\,500$ visitors
$10$ hours after launching, the number of visitors decreased at a rate of $1\,500$ visitors per hour

feedback.problem: The function $x(t)$ models the number of meters traveled by a car, $t$ seconds after it sets off on a journey. What is the best interpretation of ${x}^{′}(30)=10?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The function ${x}^{′}(t)$ represents the rate at which the number of meters is changing at the moment $t$ seconds after starting its journey.

Therefore, ${x}^{′}(30)=10$ means:

$\,$ *$30$ seconds after the start of the journey, the distance traveled increased at a rate of $10$ meters per second*

submitted_fields.submitted_value: $30$ seconds after the start of the journey, the distance traveled increased at a rate of $10$ meters per second
